title: Why Corals Turn White

segments.say: A coral reef looks like rock. But it is built by tiny animals, and they share their homes with even tinier plants.
Each coral polyp hosts algae inside its tissue. The algae make food from sunlight, and give the coral most of its colour.

anim.title: Food from the algae
anim.below: of a coral's energy can come from its algae

segments.say: It's a good deal for both. The algae can supply up to ninety per cent of the coral's energy.

anim.title: Bleaching
items: The sea stays too warm for weeks

segments.say: But if the water stays too warm for weeks, even a degree above the usual summer peak, the coral is stressed. It pushes the algae out, and its white skeleton shows through.
A bleached coral is not dead yet. If the water cools in time, the algae can return. If the heat lasts, the coral starves.
India has reefs in four places: the Gulf of Mannar, the Gulf of Kachchh, Lakshadweep, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. In twenty twenty-four, NOAA confirmed the fourth global bleaching event.
For Prelims: bleaching is the loss of algae, caused mainly by heat, and it can be reversed if the sea cools in time.

sources: NOAA Ocean Service, 'What is coral bleaching?': corals expel the zooxanthellae algae living in their tissues when stressed by changes such as temperature, turning white; bleached corals are not dead but are under more stress and at risk of death
NOAA Ocean Service, 'Corals' tutorial: zooxanthellae provide up to 90% of the coral's energy needs
NOAA Coral Reef Watch: bleaching risk rises when temperatures stay about 1°C above the usual maximum for weeks; NOAA confirmed the fourth global coral bleaching event on 15 April 2024
NCERT Class 11, India: Physical Environment / Ministry of Environment reports: India's major reef areas are the Gulf of Mannar, Gulf of Kachchh, Lakshadweep and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands

quiz.q: What gives most corals their colour?
quiz.why: The algae give the coral its colour; without them, the white skeleton shows.

options: Water that stays too warm for weeks
quiz.why: Heat stress makes corals push out their algae.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT one of India's main reef areas?
quiz.why: Chilika is a lagoon; the reefs are in Mannar, Kachchh, Lakshadweep and the Andamans.

reviewNote: Facts were read against NOAA's coral pages and Coral Reef Watch's 2024 announcement, and NCERT for India's reef areas. Photos are NOAA's, from Florida. Moving facts: the global bleaching event may be updated by NOAA.
